annotations.title: Generate a reference image for a transparent video

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. The builder's "Generate image" for a reference. Spends 5 credits. Describes the subject; returns referenceRenderId immediately -- poll get_video_reference_image_status until it is completed, then use its path as referenceImagePath in plan_transparent_video. Failed images refund automatically.

prompt.description: What the reference image should show, up to 600 characters.

requestId.description: Optional UUID you choose; a retry with the same id returns the same job instead of paying again.

name: generate_video_reference_image
